title: Funnel: cylinder and frustum
statement: 11. Draw the isometric view of a funnel consisting of cylinder and a frustum of a cone. The diameter of the cylinder is 20mm and top diameter of the frustum is 70mm. The height of the frustum and cylinder are each equal to 40mm.

concepts.title: Reference funnel
concepts.instruction: Draw the coaxial Ø20 cylinder of height 40 mm and the frustum expanding from Ø20 to Ø70 over a further 40 mm.

concepts.title: Outlet base oval
concepts.instruction: Construct the Ø20 base rhombus, centre lines and successive oval arcs.

concepts.title: Cylinder upper oval
concepts.instruction: Raise the axis 40 mm and construct the Ø20 junction oval, then join the cylinder generators.

concepts.title: Upper funnel rim
concepts.instruction: Raise a further 40 mm and construct the Ø70 top rhombus and oval.

concepts.title: Frustum generators
concepts.instruction: Join the appropriate tangent points from the small junction oval to the large top oval.

concepts.title: Dimensions
concepts.instruction: Show the two separate 40 mm heights and the 20/70 mm diameters.

notes: No wall thickness is given. Do not invent a double-wall or thick rim; reproduce the reference surface outlines.
